🎮 Xbox Game Pass's December 2026 lineup is already taking shape!

Microsoft has confirmed the first five games joining Xbox Game Pass next month. Revealed so far: the surprisingly addictive co-op sandbox title "A Game About Digging A Hole," football game "Freestyle Football 2," and action game "Hela" — with more day-one and library additions expected to be announced before December begins.

🕒 Published: Nov 24, 2026, 15:48 (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: PureXbox, TrueAchievements

👥 Official: https://x.com/Xbox

💬 Which of these are you adding to your Game Pass library? Let us know below!
